title: How to build an AI clone of yourself that works 24/7

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: You can now clone your voice and face into an AI that works 24/7

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This tech is changing how businesses communicate and operate

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s an AI replica of you that can answer questions, give talks, or create content

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The best part? It uses your own voice and facial expressions, trained with just 15 minutes of video

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Marketers, educators, and customer service teams are already using it to save time and scale reach

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Your AI clone can do the same job as you — but never sleeps

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to see how your AI clone could work for you? Tap to follow and stay tuned
